doc: The game's mix (M2-AUD-02; docs/kb/audio/mix.md §4, docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md). The Audio autoload (game/audio/audio_director.gd) builds `buses` in order on start when they are missing: each sends to `send`. Assets ship at their loudness targets, so every bus is 0 dB; never fix an asset's loudness with a fader. `master_limiter`: a safety limiter on Master. `ducks`: a reason (dialogue: a dialogue box is open; battle: a battle scene is running) lowers buses by these dB, ramping at `sec`; ducks of different reasons add. `music`: crossfade_sec is the default music change, battle_in_sec the field-to-battle cut, floor_db the level a fade counts as silent and stops at, cutscene_release_sec how fast the zone bed returns when a cutscene's music lets go. beat_sync_max_wait_sec (M3-AUD-864): a music change with a fade waits for the next beat of the cue sounding (MusicDeck, its .loop.json grid), the beat halved until it is no longer than this; min_fade_sec: the shortest fade any music change in the game may use, so none is a hard cut (test_music_transitions checks every caller). zone_return_sec (M3-AUD-864, the as-played pass): once no cutscene plays, no battle is in the tree, no cue is loading and the music has been silent this long, the zone's own cue comes back, so a scene ending on silence or a one-shot, or a battle ending where it began, never leaves the field silent until the next swap (AudioDirector._step_zone_return). After a battle the zone comes back sooner, battle_return_sec after the battle leaves the tree, fading in over battle_return_fade_sec under the victory sting's tail (2.4 s), so a return to the field under 1 s has no silence gap and never clips the sting. volume_settings: an accessibility.json setting (UiSettings, 0..1) -> the buses it scales (M2-AUD-06; 0 is silence, 1 is the asset's own level); Audio applies them live. reverb (M2-AUD-10): an AudioEffectReverb on each of `buses` (a bus sends to one bus only, so World and Combat carry one each instead of a shared WorldVerb), set to a `reverb_presets` row: the zone row's `reverb` key (music.json), else `default`; a change ramps over ramp_sec. A preset holds the effect's parameters (room_size, damping, spread, hipass, dry and wet 0..1, predelay_msec 20..500, predelay_feedback 0..0.98). Rendered SFX carry their own room, so the wet stays low where they do (the shrine: mix.md §7).

dialogue._note: M3-AUD-850: World too (footsteps, villagers' work, wildlife, cutscene foley sit under a line); villagers' chat is held outright (LifeAudio.quiet). Ambience -6 (was -2; the Lead's 10-30 18:24 polish pass): a zone's beds stack (Haluna at night: its bed, the surf, the dock and the wind), and at -2 they sat level with a line's blip stream (-23.3); at -6 every zone's beds sit at least 2.7 LU under it (tools/tests/test_dialogue_clarity.py)

encounter._note: M3-AUD-864: the field music dips under the tide-line stinger as the field dims (battle_stings.json battle_stinger), released before the router's black

dry._note: no area reverb (the title, the end card, any scene without a row)

open_sea._note: open water: a faint, far, dark wash and no walls

village_lanes._note: Haluna: a short slap off plaster and timber

stone_shrine._note: the Shell Shrine: its SFX are rendered in its room (rt60 1.5 s, 22 % wet), so only a touch joins them; footsteps and anything rendered dry still sound in stone

drowned_cave._note: a drowned interior or a sea cave: long and close

battle_beach._note: the field battle: open sand; battle SFX carry their own short room (12-30 % wet)

muffle.doc: M3-AUD-22 (game/audio/bus_muffle.gd): the world heard through water. While a reason is on (Reefball's sphere: underwater), each bus's low-pass glides to cutoff_hz over ramp_sec, and back to open_hz after. Music is left out: the score is not in the water.
